settings.heading: Six channels. One decade.
settings.intro: The 48 puzzles are grouped like a night of channel surfing. Pick up the remote.

settings.name: Television
settings.intro: Eight puzzles from the shows we planned our week around: Thursday-night sitcoms, teen dramas that ended on a cliffhanger, Saturday-morning cartoons, and the talk shows, game shows and music videos in between.
settings.listings:
Sitcoms & Must-See TV|1–2
Dramas & Teen Shows|3–4
Cartoons & Kids' TV|5–6
MTV, Talk Shows & Game Shows|7–8

settings.name: Movies

settings.listings:

Comedies & Rom-Coms|11–12
Disney & Family Movies|13–14

settings.title: Title page
settings.note: A sheet of prismatic stickers under a purple hang tab: the title, the gold seal and a few 90s objects, one already peeled away.

settings.title: Autographs
settings.note: A yearbook autograph page with a form for your message, signed in pen, gel pen, marker and pencil.

settings.title: Operating Instructions
settings.note: An owner's manual page that explains how the book works, with a numbered diagram and safety notes.

settings.title: Track List
settings.note: A hand-labelled C-90 cassette card that lists all 48 puzzles, Side A and Side B.

settings.title: Cheat Codes
settings.note: The answer key opens like the codes page of a 90s game magazine. Every solved grid is in the back.
